Our Programmes

Our Programmes

Through education, psychosocial support, community empowerment and sustainable livelihood initiatives, we seek to restore hope, promote dignity and create opportunities for individuals to reach their full potential.

Educational Support

Carlos’ Crusaders Scholarships

Carlos Scholarships is an educational support initiative dedicated to keeping vulnerable children in school by assisting with school fees, uniforms, stationery and other essential educational resources.

Through the generosity of Pam and Mike, alongside other donors and well-wishers, this initiative helps children in Zimbabwe overcome financial barriers to education and pursue their dreams of a brighter future.

Together, we honour Carlos' legacy by restoring hope, creating opportunities and transforming lives, one family at a time.

Counselling and Psychosocial Support

BeHeard Zimbabwe aims to provide a safe, supportive and confidential environment where individuals and families can access psychosocial support and general counselling services.

The programme seeks to promote emotional well-being, resilience and healthy relationships.

Women and Community Empowerment

We support vulnerable individuals, particularly women, through sustainable livelihood opportunities, skills development and access to resources that encourage financial independence.

Child Protection and Welfare

We advocate for the rights, safety, education and well-being of children through community-based interventions, awareness programmes and support for vulnerable families.

Community Outreach

We undertake community outreach initiatives that respond to the needs of vulnerable individuals and families through donations, educational activities and practical assistance.
